enriched_activities.desc: Lie down on the bed. Close eyes. Remain motionless. Breathe steadily. Turn over once onto the side.

Open eyes. Sit up on the bed. Swing legs to the floor. Stand up. Walk to the bathroom door. Push the door open. Reach for the light switch. Turn on the light. Turn on the tap. Cup hands under the water. Splash water onto the face. Pick up the toothbrush. Squeeze toothpaste onto it. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth with water. Turn off the tap. Pick up the towel. Wipe face and hands. Turn off the light. Walk out of the bathroom.

Walk into the kitchen. Open the refrigerator door. Take out milk and bread. Close the refrigerator door. Place the bread on a plate. Put the plate into the microwave. Press the start button. Wait for the beep. Open the microwave door. Take out the plate. Pour milk into a cup. Sit down at the table. Pick up the bread. Eat the bread. Lift the cup. Drink the milk. Stand up. Carry the plate and cup to the sink. Rinse the plate and cup. Leave them in the sink. Walk out of the kitchen.

enriched_activities.activity: Checking emails and planning freelance illustration work
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to the desk in Bedroom 2. Pull out the chair. Sit down. Press the power button on the computer. Wait for the screen to load. Move the mouse. Click the email icon. Scroll through the inbox. Open several emails. Click reply. Type on the keyboard. Close the email window. Open the illustration project folder. Double-click the file. View the canvas. Pick up the notebook. Write a to-do list with a pen. Place the notebook on the desk.

Sit at the desk. Move the mouse to open the drawing software. Select the brush tool. Draw lines on the tablet with the stylus. Press the keyboard shortcuts to zoom in. Zoom out. Adjust the layer panel. Add a new layer. Continue drawing. Stop and stretch both arms. Stand up. Walk to the space heater. Press the power button to turn it on. Return to the chair. Sit down. Pick up the stylus. Continue drawing. Adjust the desk lamp arm. Save the file. Take a sip of water from the cup.

Walk into the kitchen. Greet Member 1. Ask Member 1 what to cook. Open the refrigerator door. Take out vegetables. Close the door. Place the vegetables on the counter. Pick up a knife. Cut the vegetables on the cutting board. Hand the cutting board to Member 1. Turn on the induction cooker. Pour oil into the pan. Stir the vegetables with a spatula. Turn off the induction cooker. Carry the pan to the table.

enriched_activities.activity: Eating lunch with Member 1 and chatting about the day
enriched_activities.desc: Pull out a chair. Sit down at the table next to Member 1. Pick up chopsticks. Pick up food from the plate. Eat. Lift the bowl. Drink soup. Turn to Member 1. Ask Member 1 about the morning errands. Nod at Member 1's reply. Tell Member 1 about the illustration deadline. Pick up food again. Put down the chopsticks. Stand up. Carry the bowl to the sink.

enriched_activities.activity: Going for a walk in the neighborhood
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to the entryway. Pick up the jacket. Put on the jacket. Put on shoes. Open the door. Step outside. Walk along the sidewalk. Turn left at the corner. Walk past the shops. Slow down at the park entrance. Continue walking along the path. Turn around. Walk back along the same route. Reach the door. Open the door. Step inside. Take off the shoes. Take off the jacket. Hang the jacket on the hook.

Walk to the desk. Pull out the chair. Sit down. Press the space bar to wake the computer. Move the mouse. Open the illustration file. Pick up the stylus. Draw lines on the tablet. Adjust the brush size with the keyboard. Add color to the drawing. Switch to the eraser tool. Erase the edges. Zoom in on the details. Save the file. Stand up. Walk to the space heater. Adjust the dial. Return to the chair. Sit down. Continue drawing. Alternate between the keyboard and the stylus. Save the file again. Close the software. Push the chair back.

Walk into the kitchen. Greet Member 1. Open the refrigerator door. Take out meat and vegetables. Close the door. Place them on the counter. Pick up a knife. Cut the meat on the cutting board. Wash the vegetables under the tap. Turn on the oven. Place the tray into the oven. Turn on the induction cooker. Pour oil into the pan. Stir the ingredients with a spatula. Ask Member 1 to pass the salt. Sprinkle salt into the pan. Turn off the induction cooker. Carry the dishes to the table.

Pull out a chair. Sit down at the table opposite Member 1. Pick up chopsticks. Pick up food. Eat. Lift the soup bowl. Drink soup. Turn to Member 1. Ask Member 1 about the community program planning. Answer Member 1's question about the illustration project. Pick up food again. Chew. Put down the chopsticks. Wipe mouth with a napkin. Stand up.

enriched_activities.activity: Cleaning up after dinner and washing dishes with Member 1
enriched_activities.desc: Pick up the plates from the table. Carry them to the sink. Scrape the leftovers into the bin. Hand the plates to Member 1. Pick up a sponge. Squeeze dish soap onto the sponge. Wipe a plate. Rinse the plate under the tap. Place the plate in the drying rack. Pick up a bowl. Wipe the bowl. Rinse the bowl. Place the bowl in the rack. Wipe the counter with a cloth. Turn off the tap. Dry hands with a towel.

enriched_activities.activity: Reading or sketching while Member 1 plays video games
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to the living room. Sit down on the sofa. Pick up the sketchbook from the side table. Pick up a pencil. Open the sketchbook. Draw lines on the page. Look up at Member 1. Watch Member 1 press the buttons on the game console. Look down at the sketchbook. Continue drawing. Turn to a new page. Pick up an eraser. Rub out a line. Put down the eraser. Continue drawing with the pencil.

enriched_activities.activity: Reading and sketching while Member 1 watches a TV show
enriched_activities.desc: Pick up the book from the side table. Open the book. Read a page. Turn the page. Look up at the TV screen. Look down at the book. Read another page. Pick up the pencil. Sketch a figure in the sketchbook. Put down the pencil. Turn the page of the book. Read. Adjust posture on the sofa. Close the book. Place the book on the side table.

Pick up the sketchbook again. Open it to the last page. Pick up the pencil. Draw several strokes. Shade an area with the pencil. Put down the pencil. Pick up the book. Open the book. Read two pages. Turn the page. Read. Close the book. Place the book on the side table. Pick up the sketchbook. Look at the drawing. Close the sketchbook. Place it on the side table. Stand up from the sofa.

Walk to the bathroom door. Push the door open. Reach for the light switch. Turn on the light. Turn on the tap. Cup hands under the water. Splash water onto the face. Pick up the toothbrush. Squeeze toothpaste onto it. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Turn off the tap. Pick up the towel. Wipe the face. Turn on the water heater. Wait. Turn off the water heater. Turn off the light. Walk out of the bathroom.
Walk into Bedroom 2. Turn off the desk lamp. Pull back the blanket. Lie down on the bed. Pull the blanket over the body. Close eyes. Remain still. Breathe steadily.
